scope: Frozen Kodak24 x QP5 convolution arithmetic only; active-neighbour and stale-neighbour coupling have the same conv count. Excludes tile packing, memory, router, entropy and latency.
formula: Deployed frame_relative_cost + mean executed suffix blocks per tile × [(9C)/(block MAC per feature pixel)] × [trunk share/12] × [((P+2)^2/P^2)-1]; no-repair subtracts grid seam-repair share.
